problem.title: Design Browser History
problem.problemStatement: Design a browser history manager that supports the following operations: visit(url) — Visit a new webpage. back(steps) — Move back by at most steps pages. forward(steps) — Move forward by at most steps pages. Initially, the browser starts at the homepage. Process a sequence of operations and print the current page after every back() and forward() operation.
problem.input: A homepage URL. Integer q. Next q operations.
problem.output: Print the current page after every back() and forward() operation.
problem.constraints: 1 <= q <= 5 × 10^4 URL length does not exceed 100 characters.
